listenings.text: Hello, I'm Arjun, and I am the founder of a small startup in Bangalore. My company makes an app for small restaurants. The app takes online orders, so the restaurant doesn't need a big delivery platform. Today about eight hundred restaurants use the app. My partner, Meera, writes the code, and I talk to the clients. Our product is good, but our marketing is weak. We don't have a marketing team, and we don't track our campaigns. So what do we need? We need more leads, and we need to understand our data. That is why I want to talk to a growth consultancy.

Hi, my name is Katrin. I am the CRM manager at an online fashion store in Hamburg, in Germany. My team has four people. Every week we send emails to more than a million customers. But the emails are only the first step. We track everything: who opens the email, who clicks, and who buys. Our data analyst, Jonas, prepares the numbers. I read them and decide the next campaign. My director doesn't want long reports. Every Friday she asks for a short report, one page, with actionable ideas. What does actionable mean for her? It means: tell me what to do on Monday.
